what: Best PERIODIC fit known for this problem (OG 37.8): a sustained oscillator, period 2.80, one spike per period. See README, 'What the fits are, dynamically'.
provenance: 2026-09-10. Start built by reasoning from a random box draw: exact 9-rate time rescale to the data's period 2.70, phase from the limit-cycle state 0.79 before a peak, unit symmetries + clipping into the box, scale/offset profiled; then PyBNF ms (8 segments, coarsening 2, wall 400 s) to OG 38.34 and a gntr polish (4000 iterations) to OG 37.84. The start-construction scripts are not in campaign/ yet; this vector is committed so its score and dynamics are reproducible: python3 campaign/is_periodic.py
